videoId.description: YouTube video id -- click-to-embed. Use `href` instead for non-YouTube talks.

href.description: External link used instead of videoId (e.g. a SlideShare deck).

img.description: Module-relative path to the stage cover, resolved via ctx.asset().

thumb.description: Module-relative path to the rail thumbnail, resolved via ctx.asset().

href.description: External URL, or a module-relative asset path (e.g. downloads/x.pdf).
